text:
Situation: Corvale Lakeside holds 15 units of sertraline hydrochloride 25 mg tablets (NDC 68788404503) at 1.8 units per day, providing 8.5 days on hand. Corvale East holds 208 units at 6.7 per day, providing 31.1 days. Corvale General holds 224.99 units at 7.9 per day, providing 28.6 days. The drug is not on the FDA shortage list as of 2026-10-21.

Why (FDA record): The labeler is Preferred Pharmaceuticals Inc. (SPL set 8f5a71b2). FDA inspection 1270956 of the facility (FEI 3004582966) ended 2025-05-27 and was classified VAI; the classification was known 2025-07-30. Prior inspections in 2009, 2015, 2018, and 2020 were also VAI.

Our position: Links between the shortage and the inspection record are weak. Current allocation policies must be verified and the labeler contacted to confirm any supply constraints.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 10 units from Corvale East to Corvale Lakeside — needs pharmacy director (transfer request).
2. Transfer 10 units from Corvale General to Corvale Lakeside — needs pharmacy director (transfer request).
3. Buy from A-S Medication Solutions — needs buyer.
4. Buy from Accord Healthcare, Inc. — needs buyer.
5. Buy from Advanced Rx Pharmacy of Tennessee, LLC — needs buyer.

Not recommended: No clinical dosing changes or formulary substitutions; those are for treating clinicians and the committee.
